atAGlance: Bún gà nướng is rice vermicelli with grilled chicken, usually with herbs, cucumber, pickles, peanuts, and fish-sauce dip.
whatItIs: Bún gà nướng is grilled chicken over cool rice vermicelli with herbs, pickles, peanuts, and fish-sauce dip. It is lighter than a rice plate but still smoky and filling.
howToEnjoy: Pour the fish-sauce dip slowly, then toss the grilled chicken, herbs, pickles, peanuts, and bún from the bottom. The smoky chicken should meet the cool noodles in every bite.
howLocalsOrder: Order bún gà nướng when you want the grilled flavor of a chicken plate but in a fresh noodle bowl. Ask for no peanuts or no chili before the bowl is assembled.
worthKnowing: This is a good first dry-bún order for travelers: familiar grilled chicken, but with the herb-and-fish-sauce rhythm that makes Vietnamese noodle bowls sing.
goodToKnow: Ask for the fish-sauce dressing on the side if you want to control the sweet-salty pour over the noodles.
